title: The Public's Views on Climate Policies in Seven Large Global South Countries
abstract:
While public attitudes regarding climate change have been widely explored in the global north, survey work is still limited in the global south countries. Here we analysed survey data (
n
= 8,400) from Chile, Colombia, India, Kenya, Nigeria, South Africa and Vietnam to understand climate knowledge, trusted information sources and policy preferences. Our results indicate that scientists stand out as the most trusted information source in all countries except Vietnam and trust in scientists correlates with increased climate knowledge. Respondents agree with the urgency of the climate change challenge, but prioritizing policies to mitigate climate change substantially declines when policy trade-offs are introduced. There is broad agreement for earmarking carbon tax revenue towards health and education, renewable energy subsidies and clean technology R&D, but little support for deficit reduction or uniform rebates.
abstract_zh: 尽管公众对气候变化的态度在全球北方已得到广泛研究，但在全球南方国家，相关调查工作仍然有限。在此，我们分析了来自智利、哥伦比亚、印度、肯尼亚、尼日利亚、南非和越南的调查数据（n = 8,400），以了解其气候知识、可信赖的信息来源以及政策偏好。我们的结果表明，除越南外，科学家在所有国家都是最受信赖的信息来源，并且对科学家的信任与气候知识的增加相关。受访者认同气候变化挑战的紧迫性，但当引入政策权衡时，优先考虑减缓气候变化政策的比例大幅下降。对于将碳税收入专门用于医疗和教育、可再生能源补贴以及清洁技术研发，各方普遍表示赞同；但对于用于减少财政赤字或统一返还，则几乎没有支持。

title: The Attitude-Behavior Dichotomy in the Time of COVID-19 An Exploration Using Generalized Structural Equation Modeling
Understanding and Valuing Human Connections to Deep-Sea Methane Seeps off Costa Rica
abstract: Methane seeps are highly productive ecosystems that provide carbon sequestration services, host diverse communities including endemic species, and serve as habitats for commercial fisheries. Little is known about the economic value the public places on them. Discrete Choice Experiments (DCEs) are administered to a sample of Costa Rican taxpayers to evaluate their willingness to pay (WTP) in monetary terms using tradeoffs made in a survey context involving three of the main attributes of methane seep ecosystems to provide insights for future conservation and management efforts. Extensive effort is devoted to understanding how Costa Ricans view different aspects of the deep sea. We find that they associate it with strange animals, natural resources, the unknown, and being far from reach. Perhaps surprisingly, they underestimate how much they know about the deep sea. We find that WTP for methane seep protection is the highest for programs that protect seeps with endemic species, followed by seeps with high climate change mitigation potential and commercial fishing habitat. Higher-income groups and women are more likely to prefer options that increase the current level of protection. We discuss how science communication and community engagement contribute to care expressed toward the deep sea.
abstract_zh: 甲烷渗漏区是生产力很高的生态系统，可提供碳封存服务，孕育包括特有物种在内的多样化群落，并为商业渔业提供栖息地。公众对其所赋予的经济价值知之甚少。我们对哥斯达黎加纳税人样本进行了离散选择实验（DCE），在包含甲烷渗漏生态系统三个主要属性的调查情境中，通过权衡取舍来评估他们的支付意愿（WTP）（以货币计），为未来的保护和管理工作提供见解。我们投入大量精力，了解哥斯达黎加人如何看待深海的不同方面。我们发现，他们将深海与奇异的动物、自然资源、未知以及遥不可及联系在一起。或许令人惊讶的是，他们低估了自己对深海的了解程度。我们发现，在保护甲烷渗漏区的项目中，对保护有特有物种的渗漏区的支付意愿最高，其次是具有高气候变化缓解潜力的渗漏区，以及商业渔业栖息地。收入较高的群体和女性更可能偏好那些能提高当前保护水平的选项。我们讨论了科学传播和社区参与如何促进人们对深海的关切。

title: Benefit Cost Analysis of Water Investments in the Anthropocene
Integrating Non-Targeted Ecosystem Services into Assessment of Natural Stormwater Treatment Systems
abstract: Natural stormwater treatment systems (NTS) are built ecosystems designed to capture and treat stormwater runoff via natural processes. Although NTS design typically targets water services, the biological communities associated with NTS (i.e., plants, animals, and microbes) can provide non-targeted functions that can result in ecosystem services, such as biodiversity, pollination, and climate regulation, or in some cases disservices. Additional co-benefits of NTS include recreation, education and outreach opportunities, and aesthetic value. A review of NTS ecosystem services and co-benefits is provided with specific examples from Los Angeles County, highlighting the need for ecosystem services indicators, standard measurements, and monitoring. As NTS become globally widespread, best practices must include the ability to holistically assess NTS performance in ways that extend beyond water treatment services. Three models are presented that can be used to evaluate NTS performance. Such information can be important in advancing NTS design, choosing spatial placement, and making choices between NTS and more traditional stormwater treatment options.
abstract_zh: 自然雨水处理系统（NTS）是通过自然过程收集和处理雨水径流的人工生态系统。尽管NTS的设计通常以水处理服务为目标，但与NTS相关的生物群落（即植物、动物和微生物）可以提供非目标功能，从而产生生态系统服务，例如生物多样性、授粉和气候调节，或者在某些情况下产生负面影响。NTS的其他协同效益包括娱乐、教育与宣传机会以及美学价值。本文以洛杉矶县的具体实例，对NTS的生态系统服务与协同效益进行了综述，并强调了建立生态系统服务指标、标准化测量方法和监测体系的必要性。随着NTS在全球范围内日益普及，最佳实践必须具备全面评估NTS绩效的能力，而不局限于水处理服务。本文提出了三种可用于评估NTS绩效的模型。这些信息对于推进NTS设计、选择空间布局，以及在NTS与更传统的雨水处理方案之间作出选择，可能都具有重要意义。

Precautionary Heuristic Management and Learning for Data-Poor Fisheries
venue: Sustainable Resource Development in the 21st Century: Essays in Memory of Peter Berck
abstract: Fisheries are subject to multiple forms of uncertainty. One of these, parameter uncertainty, has been largely ignored in the fisheries economics literature even though it is known elsewhere (e.g., macroeconomics) to play an important role in models with a similar structure. Parameter uncertainty is particularly important when data series are relatively short. Managing a fishery with incorrect parameter values for the growth function can lead to collapse. The paper models management of a renewable resource with unknown growth parameters and simulates estimation of the key parameters of the growth equation as the amount of data increases. This exercise demonstrates that, when data is sparse, a simple heuristic form of management can result in reasonable rents from the fishery, improve estimation of the growth parameters in future periods, and reduce the probability that the fishery will collapse.
abstract_zh: 渔业面临多种形式的不确定性。其中之一是参数不确定性，尽管在其他领域（例如宏观经济学）中，人们已知它在结构相似的模型中起着重要作用，但在渔业经济学文献中却大多被忽视。当数据序列相对较短时，参数不确定性尤为重要。若以错误的生长函数参数来管理渔业，可能导致渔业崩溃。本文构建了一个具有未知生长参数的可再生资源管理模型，并模拟了随着数据量增加，对生长方程关键参数的估计过程。这一模拟表明，当数据稀少时，一种简单的启发式管理形式能够带来相当可观的渔业租金，改善未来各期生长参数的估计，并降低渔业崩溃的概率。

Creation of Malaysia's Royal Belum State Park: A Case Study of Conservation in a Developing Country
abstract: The incentives for resource extraction and development make the conservation of biodiversity challenging within tropical forestlands. The 2007 establishment of the Royal Belum State Park in the Malaysian state of Perak offers lessons for creating protected areas in tropical countries where subnational governments are major forestland owners. This article elucidates the social and political forces that influenced Royal Belum’s creation. Those forces included Malaysian conservation groups’ efforts to establish the ecological uniqueness of the site and rally public support to protect it; the Perak state government, which is the landowner under Malaysia’s constitution, seeking a protection option that would minimize the economic costs to it (and perhaps generate net economic benefits); and the federal government providing a legal framework and support for park protection and ecotourism development. Successful long-run protection of Royal Belum will require action beyond simply designating the area as protected.

title: Statistical Properties of Consideration Sets
The Discrete Choice Experiment Approach to Environmental Contingent Valuation
abstract: Assessing the economic desirability of environmental policies requires estimating the value of non-market commodities. In response, several valuation techniques have been developed since the 1960s. They utilize two general data sources – revealed and stated preference data. The former refers to situations where people's choices are observed in actual market situations. Conversely, stated preference data refers to situations in which choices are observed in a survey context. Stated preference (SP) methods allow collection of information about respondent preferences for the environmental amenities of interest by observing choices in hypothetical situations presented in a survey. Observed choices are contingent on scenarios posed in the survey and the environmental economics literature commonly uses the term contingent valuation (CV) to describe the process of utilizing stated preference data for valuation. Additionally, there are many different ways to elicit preference information in a CV study and the one most commonly used are discrete choice experiments (DCE). Contingent valuation is an inherently more flexible tool than revealed preference (RP) techniques, such as hedonic pricing, averting behavior and the travel cost method, because in principle it is possible to use it to examine preferences for provision levels of goods that are substantially different from those currently observed or those observed in the past.
abstract_zh: 评估环境政策的经济合意性，需要估算非市场商品的价值。为此，自20世纪60年代以来，人们开发了若干估值技术。这些技术利用两类基本数据来源：显示性偏好数据和陈述性偏好数据。前者指在实际市场情境中观察到的人们的选择。相反，陈述性偏好数据指在调查情境中观察到的选择。陈述性偏好（SP）方法允许通过观察调查中所呈现的假设情境下的选择，来收集受访者对相关环境舒适物偏好的信息。所观察到的选择取决于调查中设定的情景，环境经济学文献通常使用“条件价值评估”（CV）一词来描述利用陈述性偏好数据进行估值的过程。此外，在条件价值评估研究中引出偏好信息的方法有很多种，其中最常用的是离散选择实验（DCE）。与特征价格法、规避行为法和旅行成本法等显示性偏好（RP）技术相比，条件价值评估本质上是一种更为灵活的工具，因为原则上它可以用来考察那些与当前或过去所观察到的情形有显著差异的商品供给水平所对应的偏好。

Discounting Behavior and Environmental Decisions
venue: Journal of Neuroscience, Psychology and Economics
abstract: Discounting plays a major role in the life cycle of environmental and natural resource policies. Evaluating centuries-scale problems like climate change with standard dis-count rates yields results that many find ethically unacceptable. Paradoxes abound. Low discount rates are urged for determining the net benefits of climate change, while households fail to undertake energy conservation actions that have payback periods of only a few years. Efforts to uncover discount rates from revealed and stated preferences suggest that a variety of confounding factors may be simultaneously in play. Common property resources provide an example of how market failures can lead to behavior consistent with extreme discounting that can be addressed through effective policy. Finally, politicians who make ultimate policy decisions may have incentives to act in accordance with discount rates not socially optimal.
abstract_zh: 贴现在环境与自然资源政策的生命周期中扮演着重要角色。若用标准贴现率来评估气候变化这类以世纪为尺度的问题，所得结果在许多人看来是伦理上不可接受的。各种悖论层出不穷。在确定气候变化的净收益时，人们主张采用较低的贴现率，然而家庭却未能采取那些仅需几年即可收回成本的节能行动。从显示性偏好和陈述性偏好中揭示贴现率的努力表明，可能有多种混杂因素同时发挥作用。公共资源提供了一个例子，说明市场失灵如何导致与极端贴现相一致的行为，而这种行为可以通过有效的政策加以解决。最后，最终作出政策决定的政治家，可能有动机依据并非社会最优的贴现率行事。

Fisheries Management Under Cyclical Population Dynamics
abstract: Cycles in environmental conditions (e.g., sea-surface temperature) directly impact fish growth. This paper extends the classical Gordon-Schaefer fishery model by replacing the constant growth rate with a cyclical growth rate. The optimal harvest rate is shown to fluctuate, but the cycle of the harvest rate lags the cycle of the biological growth function with the highest harvest rate occurring after biological conditions start to decline. Simulations contrast various fishing policies and illustrate the proclivity to crash a fishery if it is wrongfully managed as if there is a constant growth rate with i.i.d. environmental shocks. Finally, we show that small cyclical fluctuations in one species can result in large fluctuations in the optimal harvest rate of another species if the fish species are interlinked through predator-prey relationships.
abstract_zh: 环境条件的周期性变化（例如海表温度）会直接影响鱼类生长。本文对经典的戈登—谢弗渔业模型进行了扩展，以周期性生长率取代恒定生长率。研究表明，最优捕捞率会出现波动，但捕捞率的周期滞后于生物生长函数的周期，捕捞率最高的时期出现在生物条件开始下降之后。模拟比较了多种捕捞政策，并说明了如果将渔业错误地当作具有恒定增长率且存在独立同分布环境冲击的情形来管理，其崩溃的可能性会很大。最后，我们表明，如果两种鱼类通过捕食者—猎物关系相互关联，那么一个物种的微小周期性波动，可能会导致另一个物种的最优捕捞率出现较大幅度的波动。

The Relationship Between Air Pollution Emissions and Income: U.S. Data
abstract: Considerable interest has focused on the possible existence of an environmental Kuznets curve, whereby pollution first increases but later falls with increasing income. Empirical studies have concentrated on a wide spectrum of countries and run into inevitable problems of data comparability and quality. We avoid these problems by looking at seven types of air emissions across the 50 US states and find all seven pollutants decrease with increasing per capita income. We also find strong evidence of heteroscedasticity with respect to the income–emissions relationship: lower-income states display much greater variability in per capita emission levels than higher-income states. Additionally, we look at the best measured of these emissions, air toxics, for the period 1988–94. Using a simple sign test, we find support for the notion that an increase in income is associated with a decrease in per capita emissions. However, the change in emissions appears to be unrelated to the magnitude of the change in income. We do find, though, that the reduction in per capita emissions is increasing both in terms of the 1988 level of per capita emissions and income. Possible implications of these results for the development process are discussed.
abstract_zh: 环境库兹涅茨曲线引起了广泛关注，即随着收入增长，污染先上升后下降。实证研究主要集中于各类国家，并不可避免地遇到数据可比性和质量问题。我们通过考察美国50个州的七类大气排放物规避了这些问题，发现这七种污染物的人均排放量均随人均收入的增加而下降。我们还发现，收入—排放关系存在明显的异方差性：低收入州的人均排放水平比高收入州的变异性大得多。此外，我们考察了这些排放物中测量得最好的一类——有毒空气污染物，时间跨度为1988–94年。使用简单的符号检验，我们发现收入增加与人均排放下降相关的观点获得了支持。然而，排放变化似乎与收入变化的幅度无关。不过，我们确实发现，人均排放的减少幅度既随1988年人均排放水平的提高而增加，也随收入的提高而增加。文中还讨论了这些结果对发展过程的可能含义。

abstract: This paper presents the findings of a study designed to determine the national benefits of freshwater pollution control. By using data from a national contingent valuation survey, we estimate the aggregate benefits of meeting the goals of the Clean Water Act. A valuation function is estimated which depicts willingness to pay as a function of water quality, income, and other variables. Several validation checks and tests for specific biases are performed, and the benefit estimates are corrected for missing and invalid responses. The two major policy implications from our work are that the benefits and costs of water pollution control efforts are roughly equal and that many of the new policy actions necessary to ensure that all water bodies reach at least a swimmable quality level will not have positive net benefits.
abstract_zh: 本文报告了一项旨在确定淡水污染控制全国性收益的研究结果。利用一项全国性条件价值评估调查的数据，我们估算了实现《清洁水法》目标的总体收益。我们估计了一个价值函数，将支付意愿刻画为水质、收入及其他变量的函数。我们进行了多项验证检查和特定偏差检验，并对缺失和无效回答进行了修正。我们的研究得出的两项主要政策含义是：水污染控制努力的收益与成本大致相当；而为确保所有水体至少达到可供游泳的水质水平而必需的许多新政策行动，其净收益将不为正。
